text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Passing in front of school gates—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, hold on, Opera O-kun! Haven't I constantly
told you to stop filling room with roses?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
When living together, consider
your roommate's circumstances—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hahaha, pardon me.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yet one who is "Supreme Overlord" must remain ever beautiful.
For that, roses are an absolute necessity!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ah, that is why I said wait...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Honestly, is she even listening to me...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Quite active so early in the morning.
You're meddlesome as ever, sis.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hm, Brian?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
A messy room degrades quality of life
and lowers operational efficiency in all tasks.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I am merely stating my opinion
to prevent such an outcome—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: —Oh?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hold on, Brian. Your collar's angle appears
to be skewed 0.5 degrees from usual.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You are on student council. Your position
demands conduct and appearance to match.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: No helping it. I shall fix it for you this time.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, don't be ridiculous.
Why fuss over something so minor every time?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Pointless.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ah, hey, wait...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Wait, Brian...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Stop following me...!
I don't have time to indulge your nonsense.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Wha—did I lose sight of her...?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(Brian's acceleration
is beyond comparison to average horse girls...!)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(When she gets serious,
even I might not be able to catch up...!)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: (Kgh... must I give up?!)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No, unacceptable...! Brian's collar
bothers me too much...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Acceleration, is it...?! In that case,
should I simply train my acceleration further?!
